findings.problem: The design names typed commands, application seams, store seams and HTTP routes but does not define their command fields, result projections, typed transition outcomes, public error bodies or request/response schemas.
findings.required_change: Add decision-complete typed contracts for every WriteProposalWorkflow command/result, ReadTool command/result, proposal and execution projection, ToolActionStore transition result, and HTTP request/response/error surface. Bind actor provenance to trusted context explicitly and define the closed public status/error taxonomy before guide preparation or implementation.

findings.problem: The SupportToolGateway and reference-provider boundary lacks an executable request/result/error contract and an explicit provider-ledger state machine.
findings.required_change: Specify typed lookup_ticket, create_ticket and get_execution_outcome inputs and outputs; a closed provider error/observation taxonomy; atomic logical-identity and fingerprint rules; durable provider outcomes; deterministic fault seams; and restart-independent contract tests.

findings.location: docs/design/milestone-4-tools-human-approval.md:31-45,88-94; docs/standards/architecture.md:942-946,961-972; GitHub Issue #74 — Exact binding and policy decisions
findings.problem: The artifacts require exact compatibility but do not define the compatibility predicate, canonical digest domain or authority that determines compatibility.
findings.required_change: Define a versioned compatibility-check contract with explicit inputs, outputs and reason codes; lock canonical serialization/digests; prohibit latest resolution; default to exact identity/version/digest equality; and keep current-authority denial distinct from stale projection.

findings.problem: ExternalResourceReference does not select one integrity/unforgeability representation or define canonical protected bytes, key resolution, rotation/revocation and fail-closed outcomes.
findings.required_change: Choose one authenticated representation and verifier contract, define key-version lifecycle and verification order, and guarantee no unverified provider identity reaches the gateway.

findings.problem: Deterministic atomic winner lacks a linearization rule.
findings.required_change: Define the winner as the first expected-revision CAS commit and return the persisted winner/revision to every loser without actor precedence.

findings.problem: The phrase Child PRs #75–#79 can be read as preassigning PR numbers equal to issue numbers.
findings.required_change: Refer to one PR per issue and record actual GitHub PR identities after creation.
